responsibility: Defines the GCC OS configuration variant for VxWorks AE/653-style targets. It replaces the normal VxWorks RTP-oriented specs with AE-specific header search paths, vThreads versus kernel-mode preprocessor settings, relocatable linking defaults, simplified library handling, disabled ctor/dtor section support, no native TLS, and AE-specific builtins and DWARF defaults. This header is the dedicated configuration layer for the AE family, contrasting with vxworks.h for standard VxWorks targets.
